name: SmartLink Chatbox
author: fxgadgets

sections.description:
SmartLink Chatbox is a lightweight and responsive WordPress plugin that allows you to display floating buttons for WhatsApp, Telegram, Phone Call, and a custom link. Site admins can fully control the button text, image, background color, text color, and the order of image and text. The buttons are highly customizable via the admin panel.

Key Features

  • Floating buttons for WhatsApp, Telegram, Phone Call, and a Custom URL.
  • Fully customizable styles including colors, text, and images.
  • Set button position (left, right, center).
  • Choose content order: image-text or text-image.
  • Built-in default images for all buttons (stored in plugin folder).
  • Reset to Defaults button in the settings panel.
  • NEW: Excluded Pages – Specify pages where chat buttons should NOT appear.
  • NEW: Two exclusion modes – Exact match or contains text.
  • Responsive design optimized for mobile and desktop.
  • Clean, minimal, and fast-loading.

Excluded Pages Feature

You can now prevent chat buttons from appearing on specific pages. Simply go to the settings panel and:

  1. Enter the URLs or paths in the “Excluded Pages” textarea (one per line).
  2. Choose the exclusion mode:
    • Exact: Matches the full URL (e.g., /about matches https://yoursite.com/about)
    • Contains: Matches if the URL contains the text (e.g., /product matches /product/123 and /products/)
  3. Save your settings.

This is perfect for excluding pages like:
– Contact page
– About page
– Specific product pages
– Blog archives
– Any page where you don’t want chat buttons
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > SmartLink Chatbox to configure the buttons.
sections.faq:
How can I change the text or image of each button?

Go to SmartLink Chatbox settings, where you can customize the text, image URL, and link for each button. If no image is provided, the plugin uses built-in default images.

Can I reorder the text and image?

Yes. Use the Content Order setting to choose between image-text or text-image.

How do I reset all settings to default?

Click the Reset to Defaults button on the settings page. This removes saved settings and loads the original defaults.

How can I hide buttons on specific pages?

Use the new Excluded Pages feature. Enter the URLs or paths where you don’t want buttons to appear, and choose the exclusion mode that works best for your needs.

What exclusion modes are available?

Two modes are supported:
– Exact: Matches exact URL (e.g., /about matches https://yoursite.com/about)
– Contains: Matches if URL contains the text (e.g., /product matches /product/123)

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. It is a lightweight plugin with no external dependencies.

2.2.0

  • New Feature: Excluded Pages – Specify URLs or paths where chat buttons should NOT appear.
  • New: Two exclusion modes: Exact and Contains.
  • New: Excluded pages section in admin settings.
  • Improved: Better security with nonce validation and capability checks.
  • Improved: Full English interface for all settings.
  • Updated documentation and readme.

2.1.1

  • Fixed: Corrected image folder path (imgaes → images).
  • Improved: Default images now load properly on fresh installs.

2.1

  • Added: Phone Call button with customizable number, text, image, and colors.
  • Added: Default images for all buttons (WhatsApp, Telegram, Link, Phone).
  • Added: Reset to Defaults button in the admin panel.
  • Improved: Cleaner layout for settings sections.
  • Improved: All buttons now support default values without manual input.

2.0

  • Added: Strict validation for WhatsApp and Telegram buttons — buttons appear only if both URL and image are provided.
  • Improved: Better image and text ordering logic.
  • Fixed: Bug causing buttons to display without images.
  • Cleaned code structure for better readability and future expansion.

1.0

  • Initial release.
  • WhatsApp, Telegram, and custom link support.
  • Positioning and content order options.
  • Admin settings page with live configuration.
